lessons_used: Evidence is still thin across all change types; at least 2 tests of a kind are required to establish a rule.

candidates.title: Redesign Story Screen with Split Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the opening story screen using a split layout with companion imagery and clear intro text.
candidates.why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off, indicating potential friction on initial welcome screens.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Meet your interactive pet that lives right on your desktop, ready to hang out while you work.

guard.reason: Redesigning the story screen with a split layout is permitted inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Addresses 23.8% drop-off and 514s duration on initial welcome, but evidence relies solely on funnel data.

candidates.title: Defer Sign In After Pet Selection
candidates.change: Move the sign_in step after pet creation screens so users pick their pet before registering.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right after path selection. Letting users choose a pet first increases motivation to sign in.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to occur after pet selection is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users; deferring friction until after investment usually boosts sign-in conversion.

candidates.title: Add Desktop Placement Checklist Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new screen before home_intro that guides users through desktop permissions and visibility setup.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not appearing on desktop and 3 emails reporting confusion about desktop controls.

new_desktop_prep.headline: Desktop Setup Guide
new_desktop_prep.body: Ensure your pet renders smoothly on your desktop.

guard.reason: Adding a new setup checklist screen before home_intro is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Supported by 35.2% finish drop-off and 6 support emails, but adding new screens carries release overhead and mixed confidence.

candidates.title: Add Custom Pet Guidelines Sub Flow
candidates.change: Insert a photo guidelines screen before photo upload to explain optimal pet photo lighting and pose.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption stage conversion is low at 60.9%.

new_photo_tips.headline: Photo Upload Tips
new_photo_tips.body: Follow these quick tips for the best custom pet rendering results.

guard.reason: Adding a new photo guidelines sub-flow screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest drop step (39.1%) with 3 support reports, but prior test of new screens in adoption yielded -4.2% lift.

candidates.title: Add Account Persistence Warning on Sign In
candidates.change: Display a hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that pet data connects directly to the authenticated account.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after logging in with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Use your primary account to keep your pet saved and synced.

guard.reason: Adding account persistence hints to sign-in is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence with 8 support emails and 27.1% sign-in drop-off; cheap to implement via text/hint config.

candidates.title: Add Generation Status Progress Bar
candidates.change: Show dynamic time estimates and progress info on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-off due to unknown wait times.

waiting.hint: Generating companion graphics... This takes about 2 minutes.

guard.reason: Adding real time estimates and progress info to the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Home step has long wait times (mean 2336s); progress indicators reliably reduce perceived wait frustration.

candidates.title: Desktop Ready Background Notification
candidates.change: Enable background completion notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app.
candidates.why: Users wait an average of 2336s on the waiting screen, leading to abandonment before setup finishes.

waiting.body: You can minimize this window. We'll alert you when your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Enabling background completion notifications on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Helps recover users abandoning during 2336s mean wait time, though requires native notification release.

candidates.title: Show Starter Pet Accessory Bonus
candidates.change: Display a bonus badge on choose_path offering a free starter accessory upon completing setup.
candidates.why: Overall onboarding completion is only 17.8%, requiring early value hooks to boost end-to-end conversion.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Path & Claim Free Starter Outfit

guard.reason: Onboarding copy cannot mention free extras or bonus gifts.

candidates.title: Two Column Adoption Certificate Layout
candidates.change: Change the adoption certificate screen layout to two_column for a cleaner certificate presentation.
candidates.why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate at 60.9% and takes a long mean time of 1017s.

guard.reason: Redesigning the adoption certificate layout is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Targets largest drop-off step (39.1%) with quick layout configuration, though lacks support email evidence.

candidates.title: Clear Desktop Control Quick Reference
candidates.change: Update home_intro text to clearly detail how to right-click, hide, or talk to the pet once on desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet anytime to adjust controls, hide it, or start chatting.

guard.reason: Updating home intro quick reference copy is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Clears up confusion reported in 3 support emails for the 35.2% finish drop step; cost is minimal text update.

held_by_harm_budget: Redesign Story Screen with Split Layout
Add Account Persistence Warning on Sign In
lessons_next: Evidence is still thin across all change types; at least 2 tests of a kind are required to establish a rule.
